The '''Northern Dependencies''' were a subsection of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that had been long-settled and generally looked outward.

It consisted of locations north of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] on the galactic plane, but only to the far reaches of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Inclusive in the area was [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]], Inner Rim worlds along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] such as [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]], and planets such as [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]] and [[Carratos]] on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]]. The western boundary of this region was an area known as [[The Negs]].<ref name="TEA" />

Inhabitants of the Northern Dependencies did not think much of the [[Core Worlds]] from which they originated; having being stereotyped as mighty [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and businessmen, they held in contempt the [[Arrowhead]]'s preoccupation with bureaucracy, politics and self-importance, rather their focus looked to opportunities outward, along the Hydian, and towards the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="TEA" />
